'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War on terror]]
**[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
***[[Drone strikes in Afghanistan]]
****[[Killing of Ayman al-Zawahiri]]
*****A [[United States|U.S.]] [[drone warfare|drone strike]] in [[Kabul]] kills [[Ayman al-Zawahiri]], [[al-Qaeda|al-Qaeda's]] leader since the [[Killing of Osama bin Laden|death of Osama bin Laden]] in 2011. The airstrike is also the first [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] action in [[Afghanistan]] following the [[2021 Taliban offensive|Taliban's takeover of Afghanistan]] last year. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2022/08/01/zawahiri-al-qaeda-killed/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62387167 (BBC News)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[2021–2022 Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis]]
***Shelling and heavy gunfire is reported near two villages by [[Republic of Artsakh|Artsakh]] authorities in [[Nagorno-Karabakh]]. The reports are denied by [[Azerbaijan]] and [[Russian forces]] in the region. [https://jam-news.net/shelling-in-karabakh-and-gunfire-at-the-armenian-azerbaijani-border-whats-happening-opinions-from-yerevan/ (JAM news)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The first ship with Ukrainian grain leaves the port of [[Odesa]] for [[Lebanon]] after an agreement was signed with [[Russia]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/russia-ukraine-updates-first-grain-shipment-leaves-odesa/a-62666980 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[July 2022 United States floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing [[flash flood]]s in [[Kentucky]] and [[Virginia]], [[United States]], increases to 35 with 37 people missing. [https://www.kentucky.com/news/state/kentucky/article264019321.html (''Lexington Herald Leader'')]
*Twenty-four people are killed by heavy flooding in eastern [[Uganda]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/floods-kill-least-24-uganda-red-cross-govt-officials-2022-08-01/ (Reuters)]
*Nine people are killed and 76 others are injured after a fuel tanker explodes in Bent Bayya, [[Wadi al Hayaa District]], [[Libya]]. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-africa-fires-libya-tripoli-1b95e45438cf6df2950117bed9bada6b (AP)]
*More than two million people are under [[red flag warning]]s in the United States as [[wildfire]]s continue to spread in [[Northern California]], [[Oregon]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], [[Montana]], [[South Dakota]], and [[Nebraska]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/08/01/weather/california-mckinney-fire-monday/index.html (CNN)]
*A [[Pakistan Army Aviation Corps]] helicopter carrying several senior [[Pakistan Army]] officials crashes in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]]. Rescuers have not yet reached the crash site due to [[2022 Pakistan floods|ongoing floods]] in the region. [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/pakistan-army-chopper-with-senior-military-officials-onbaord-goes-missing-balochistan-1982604-2022-08-01 (''India Today'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in India]]
***[[India]] reports its first confirmed [[monkeypox]] related death in [[Kerala]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/india-confirms-its-first-monkeypox-death-2022-08-01/ (Reuters)]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in Peru]]
***[[Peru]] reports its first confirmed death from monkeypox in a 45-year-old male with underlying health conditions. [https://www.infobae.com/america/peru/2022/08/01/viruela-del-mono-confirman-primera-muerte-a-causa-de-este-virus-en-el-peru/ (Infobae)]
**[[Ghana]] reports its first confirmed death from monkeypox. [https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/tori-62377565 (BBC News)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[New Zealand]] has fully reopened its international borders after two years, becoming the last country in the [[western world]] to open for tourists. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62373913 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*A post made by the [[VK (service)|VK]] social media account of [[Dmitry Medvedev]], the incumbent Deputy Chairman of the Security Council of Russia and former President of Russia, refers to [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] and [[Kazakhstan]] as "artificial" creations and advocates the return of the two countries to Russian sovereignty. The post is quickly taken down and attributed to hackers. [https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-medvedev-controversial-post-vk-hackers/31970322.html (RFE/RL)]
